cases.name: Lorraine Hatzakorzia
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
On 4/28/2007, a fisherman contacted police after spotting a human head wrapped in a bag in the water being circled by alligators. Authorities retrieved the head, but couldn't determine her age and gender.

She was still alive when they decapitated her. 

"She was still alive when somebody started to cut her neck. She may have been unconscious and we hope most likely unconscious but she was still a living being as she suffered horrible, horrific injuries to her neck," Gregg Rossman, a former Broward County prosecutor said.
